entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! My VeloBand is a piece of junk and I want my money back. This is ridiculous.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
Don't give me a script! It's a technical fault! The pulse reader is completely not working, and the whole thing won't sync with the app. It's broken, plain and simple.

I see. Thank you for clarifying. It sounds like it could be a sync issue, which our technical support team is specialized in handling. I'd be happy to transfer you to them so they can troubleshoot and get it working for you.

No! Absolutely not! I am not spending another hour on the phone being passed around. The product you sold me is defective! I've had it for 17 days and it's useless. I demand a refund, not a tech session. Get me your manager right now.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. There's no need to speak with a manager, I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your account and review our return policy.
You better. I'll be leaving reviews about this everywhere if you don't.

Okay, one moment please... I see the order here. You received it 17 days ago. I've just checked our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now. I'll just need to email you a prepaid return label.
Fine. About time. Send the label to my email on file.

I've just sent that over. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Once we receive the defective device back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Again, my apologies for the trouble. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
